To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) treatment with r-hu- Epo in patients with RA and anaemia of ACD improves health-related quality life as assessed by utilities; 2) utilities correlate strongly with both disease activity and Hb levels; 3) the correlation between utilities and clinical disease variables is stronger for utilities derived from rating scales than for standard gamble utilities; and 4) utilities may be a useful instrument in the evaluation of quality of life in clinical trials with patients with rheumatological disorders.
